title: Export for Cursor
description: Export skills to Cursor's discovery location. In standard layout this is the shared .agents/skills/ folder.

title: Export for Claude
description: Export skills to Claude Code's discovery location. In standard layout this is .claude/skills/ because Claude does not yet read .agents/skills/.

title: Export for OpenAI Codex
description: Export skills to OpenAI Codex's discovery location. In standard layout this is the shared .agents/skills/ folder.

title: Export for GitHub Copilot
description: Export skills to GitHub Copilot's discovery location. In standard layout this is the shared .agents/skills/ folder.

title: Output layout
description: Control whether the exporter writes agent discovery folders or emits skills directly into the pipeline destination.

standard.label: Standard
standard.description: Export to agent skill folders based on the selected targets.

bare.label: Bare
bare.description: Export skill folders directly, without a .agents/skills or .claude/skills prefix.

title: Preserve folder hierarchy
description: Keep Supernova skill folders as category folders in the exported output. When disabled, skills are flattened and duplicate names receive numeric suffixes.

title: Add Supernova metadata
description: Add Supernova skill ID and update timestamp to the SKILL.md frontmatter metadata field.

title: Generate debug files
description: Export _debug files with raw SDK responses and generated output metadata for troubleshooting.
